Common questions

How long does it take to start?

Most schools start with fees and attendance within two weeks. We import your student list from Excel.

Can parents use it in Urdu?

Yes. The parent portal, app and messages are in Urdu and English.

Do we need new hardware?

No. ILMA works in a browser and on phones. Fingerprint or face attendance is optional.

What happens to our data?

You own it. Export it any time, and every change to marks and fees is recorded.
